answer: Logprob probes: each epoch the beacon sends every ID the same 32 forced-choice prompts (a glacier riddle, a fable's last line, a sonnet's next rhyme) and requires top-5 token logprobs. Clones of one model and config return near-identical vectors; IDs whose probe vectors stay within cosine 0.98 over 10 epochs (proposed) split one reward. Each extra seat then needs a genuinely different model, a real cost. Measured: none yet; thresholds untested.
